chat.json.notes: prompt_tokens includes cached_tokens and cache_write_tokens (subsets of prompt_tokens). completion_tokens includes reasoning_tokens. total_tokens = prompt+completion. Model id at top-level 'model'.

chat.sse.notes: stream_options.include_usage=true. Only the final chunk (choices == [], before data: [DONE]) has non-null usage; every other chunk has usage:null. The finish_reason:stop chunk is NOT the usage chunk. Same includes/subset semantics as chat.json.

chat.interrupted.sse.notes: Stream cut before finish_reason, usage chunk and [DONE]; docs: final usage chunk may not be received. Usage unknown, not zero.

chat.nousage.sse.notes: Completed stream but stream_options.include_usage not set: every chunk carries usage:null and no empty-choices chunk. Usage absent despite a clean [DONE].

responses.json.notes: input_tokens includes cached_tokens and cache_write_tokens; output_tokens includes reasoning_tokens (total = input+output). Response-level optional 'tool_usage' (image_gen/web_search) is separate from 'usage' and is not in these totals. Model id at response.model.

responses.sse.notes: Usage is only on response.completed (response.usage); response.created / response.in_progress carry usage:null. No [DONE] sentinel. Count once per response id.

responses.failed.sse.notes: Terminal response.failed with usage:null (as in docs example). Whether partial usage is ever billed/reported on failure is UNCONFIRMED.

responses.incomplete.sse.notes: Terminal response.incomplete; docs example shows usage:null. Real incomplete responses may carry usage - UNCONFIRMED; an observer must read usage from this event if present.

responses.error.sse.notes: Stream ends with in-band 'error' event and no terminal response.* event: usage unknown.

responses.background.queued.json.notes: GET /v1/responses/{id} while status is queued/in_progress: usage is null/absent. Poll until a terminal status (completed, failed, incomplete, cancelled).

responses.background.cancelled.json.notes: POST /v1/responses/{id}/cancel result; usage presence on cancelled responses is UNCONFIRMED (shown null).

responses.ws.jsonl.notes: Responses WebSocket mode (/v1/responses): server events identical to SSE streaming events; usage on response.completed only. 'stream' and 'background' are not used. One WS carries many sequential responses: sum per response id, not per connection.

responses.interrupted.ws.jsonl.notes: Socket closed mid-response, no terminal event: usage unknown.

realtime.ws.jsonl.notes: Totals = sum of response.done usage across the two responses (132+240, 121+77, 64+128). Each response.done is per-response, not cumulative, but later turns re-include earlier turns as input by design. input_tokens includes cached_tokens (subset) and text/audio/image splits. conversation.item.input_audio_transcription.completed usage (22 tokens, billed to the ASR model) is a DIFFERENT meter and is excluded here; rate_limits.updated is not usage. No cache-write counter in Realtime usage; no reasoning counter. Same events over WebRTC data channel (oai-events) and SIP/sideband WebSocket (UNCONFIRMED for byte-level identity).

realtime.cancelled.ws.jsonl.notes: response.done is always emitted, even for cancelled/failed/incomplete; usage is optional and shown absent here. Whether cancelled responses carry partial usage is UNCONFIRMED.

realtime.interrupted.ws.jsonl.notes: Connection dropped before response.done; in-band 'error' events are usually recoverable and are not usage.

live.ws.jsonl.notes: Token totals = nested response.event/response.completed usage (90/44) plus decision.event decision.usage (42/0) - two distinct meters on one socket, each once. Voice meter is SECONDS (not representable here): session.usage.updated are cumulative snapshots that replace each other (do not sum: 12, 32.5); record session.closed usage.seconds=45.8 once. Wrapped response.event deltas carry no usage.

live.interrupted.ws.jsonl.notes: No session.closed: docs say a closing connection without session.closed does not confirm finalization; final seconds unconfirmed (last snapshot is only a lower bound). No token usage seen.

embeddings.json.notes: Embeddings: usage.prompt_tokens (=input) and total_tokens only; no output counter (null, not 0). Model at top-level 'model'. Batch of inputs yields one aggregate usage.

transcription.json.notes: Token-billed ASR model: usage.type=='tokens'; input_token_details splits audio/text. Response has no 'model' field (model is only in the request).

transcription.duration.json.notes: Duration-billed ASR model: usage.type=='duration', unit is SECONDS of input audio; no token counters (all null). Do not map seconds into tokens.

transcription.sse.notes: Streaming transcription: usage only on transcript.text.done; deltas have none.

transcription.interrupted.sse.notes: Stream cut before transcript.text.done: usage absent.

images.json.notes: GPT image models only: usage tokens with input_tokens_details{text,image}; older image models (DALL-E) return no usage and bill per image (unit: images) - UNCONFIRMED shape. Optional svg_usage is a separate meter and not included.

images.sse.notes: Usage only on image_generation.completed; partial_image events carry none (and their cost is included in the final usage, UNCONFIRMED).

images.interrupted.sse.notes: Only partial images, no image_generation.completed: usage absent.

moderation.json.notes: Moderation response has id, model, results only - no usage object documented. Free endpoint; all null.

batch.output.jsonl.notes: Batch output file (output_file_id): one line per request, usage inside response.body exactly as the per-endpoint body (here /v1/chat/completions); sum lines. Body shape for other endpoints is the endpoint's own (UNCONFIRMED by explicit docs example). Lines are not ordered; key on custom_id. Output file may be empty for failed batches.

batch.errors.jsonl.notes: Error file (error_file_id): response is null, error{code,message}. No usage. Individual request-level 4xx may instead appear as an output line with response.status_code != 200 (UNCONFIRMED).

batch.object.json.notes: Batch object usage (GET /v1/batches/{id}), only populated for batches created after 2025-09-07 and only when finished; note input_tokens_details has cached_tokens only (no cache_write). Must NOT be added on top of batch.output.jsonl totals - same tokens, two views.
